comment: The full 3:03 with the first 25.70 s sped up. Silent, captions burned in. Title card 0-10.65 at 2.5x (it is a static two-line card), the 'writes back' scene 10.65-25.70 at 1.75x (a heading, then three cards whose own text carries the point). In both, the .srt's cues are replaced by one caption per scene: at these speeds the original eight would flash by at 30-50 characters per second, and the on-screen headings already say the same words. Everything from 25.70 s on is unchanged.

captions:
This is the copilot in DTwin,
a digital twin for a commercial building.

The twin doesn't only watch the building.
It writes back to it.
